wrapper_statement_policy: Exact accepted theorem types; only exported names change. Independent Challenge imports Mathlib only and inlines the relevant mathematical definitions. Solution imports copied full proofs, never Challenge.
scope: For globally convex C² real-valued f on the full joint real coordinate space, arbitrary anchor a and retained set B, the explicit sufficient scale is min(1,2*infimum of the positive-curvature ratio range), or 1 when that domain is empty. It lies in [0,1]; all nonnegative coefficients below it give tangent <= cut <= f and cut <= unit-scale Taylor cut on B. Derivatives are actual first/nested Frechet derivatives. B may retain domain/integer restrictions; a need not belong to B. Empty B and zero curvature are retained. No maximal/necessary/strictly-positive/computable scale, strict dominance, algorithmic return, master attainment, solver or performance claim is included.
